dimensions.assessment: Affects institutions of higher education disbursing federal financial aid under title IV, students completing FAFSA forms, and the Department of Education.
dimensions.evidence: require the Secretary of Education to prioritize program reviews of institutions of higher education that disburse Federal financial aid under title IV

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a priority category for program reviews and audits rather than prohibiting disbursements or imposing direct financial penalties by itself.
dimensions.evidence: Identification of an institution under subsection (a)(4)... shall not, by itself, constitute a determination that such institution has failed to meet the requirements

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative oversight activities by the Department of Education without stating specific new federal appropriations or spending figures.
dimensions.evidence: may be used to inform program reviews, audits, investigations, and other oversight activities authorized under this title

dimensions.assessment: Amends section 498A of the Higher Education Act of 1965 to alter program review priorities and add institutional identification criteria.
dimensions.evidence: To amend section 498A of the Higher Education Act of 1965 to require the Secretary of Education to prioritize program reviews

dimensions.assessment: Applies permanently to federal financial aid disbursed on or after October 1, 2026.
dimensions.evidence: each institution that has disbursed, on or after October 1, 2026, Federal financial aid under this title for an award year

missing_information: The text does not state how many institutions or students are estimated to be flagged by the identity fraud detection system.
No specific funding amounts for conducting the prioritized program reviews are provided.
importance_detail.rationale: The Student Aid Fraud Oversight and Accountability Act of 2026 requires the Department of Education to prioritize program reviews of higher education institutions that disburse federal student aid to students whose FAFSA applications present a reasonable suspicion of identity fraud without prior identity verification.
